sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Physical Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Magic Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 5 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Lowers the effect of Cost reduction by 50% when equipped in the main slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
